review_scope: Two prespecified contact sheets, 18 author-defined leaves, all four original photographs per leaf (72 images)
selection: Within each of the three labels, lexical first two, middle two, last two author leaf IDs; selected before feature classifier fitting
observations: Each displayed row shows compatible leaf outline, venation, and visible marking locations across the four original photographs.
Framing, rotation, and shadows change within rows, consistent with the source author's description of repeated photography of a leaf.
Photographs depict detached leaves against a controlled background; these are not field scene validation images.
Sheet labels and photo row indices are visible and correspond to contact_sheet_manifest.csv.
limitations: This limited visual review corroborates metadata and catches gross row mistakes; it does not certify all 538 leaf identities.
Leaf identity is attributed to the original authors' 2016 metadata, not inferred from this visual review.
No disease label was changed or diagnostically certified by visual review.
No new plant identity, field cohort, or unified pathology adjudication is established.
